title: Monomial on an extended sign vector
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, let $b$ be a sign, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. If the coordinates of $S$ are shifted forward by one position, the resulting monomial on the length-$(n+1)$ vector formed by placing $b$ before $x$ equals the monomial indexed by $S$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
